```{r table5, include=FALSE}

# ذكور
c11 <- sum(as.numeric(df$staff_title_mgr_male), na.rm = TRUE)
c21 <- sum(as.numeric(df$staff_title_asst_male), na.rm = TRUE)
c31 <- sum(as.numeric(df$staff_title_tchr_male), na.rm = TRUE)
c41 <- sum(as.numeric(df$staff_title_cslr_male), na.rm = TRUE)
c51 <- c11 + c21 + c31 + c41

# اناث
c12 <- sum(as.numeric(df$staff_title_mgr_female), na.rm = TRUE)
c22 <- sum(as.numeric(df$staff_title_asst_female), na.rm = TRUE)
c32 <- sum(as.numeric(df$staff_title_tchr_female), na.rm = TRUE)
c42 <- sum(as.numeric(df$staff_title_cslr_female), na.rm = TRUE)
c52 <- c12 + c22 + c32 + c42

# المجموع
c13 <- c11 + c12
c23 <- c21 + c22
c33 <- c31 + c32
c43 <- c41 + c42
c53 <- c51 + c52
```
